versions.changelog:
Initial release — generate concise, actionable reports from aggregated data.

- Converts complex findings into readable reports: chat digest, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
- Emphasizes only reporting changes and prioritizing what matters for readers.
- Enforces clear sourcing for all claims and separation of facts from interpretation.
- Provides delivery guidance, including chat and file-based sharing.
- Includes minimal, dependency-free HTML dashboard template.
